# Third-party VFX

All material in this folder is replaceable and isolated from gameplay code.

- `cethiel_weapon_slash`: **Weapon Slash - Effect**, Cethiel, CC0. Source: https://opengameart.org/content/weapon-slash-effect
- `reactorcore_muzzle`: **Gun Muzzle Flash Effects (Fire and Ion and Melee)**, Reactorcore, CC0. Source: https://opengameart.org/content/gun-muzzle-flash-effects-fire-and-ion-and-melee

The original ZIP archives are retained beside their extracted files for provenance. Helltaker assets are intentionally not included because the game and artbook do not grant redistribution rights.
